title: TREVCAN CAN Explorer (combined draft)
description: Read-only raw frame list and decoded signals from the reliable telemetry pipeline.

panels.title: CAN messages: raw + decoded - latest 500
panels.description: One row per frame from the last minute. Use the DBC and CAN bus selectors to reduce table churn; undecoded frames remain visible when All is selected.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "home")
  |> range(start: -1m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "can_frame")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.bus =~ /^${can_bus:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "seq" or r._field == "data" or r._field == "dlc" or r._field == "message" or r._field == "dbc" or r._field == "decoded")
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time", "car", "bus", "can_id", "ext"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with dbc: if exists r.dbc then r.dbc else "Unknown / undecoded", message: if exists r.message then r.message else "Unknown"}))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.dbc =~ /^${dbc_file:regex}$/)
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 500)
  |> keep(columns: ["dbc", "message", "_time", "bus", "can_id", "data", "decoded", "dlc", "seq", "ext", "car"])

panels.title: Captured frames per second
panels.description: Count of raw CAN frames exported to InfluxDB per second.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "home")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "can_frame" and r._field == "seq")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1s, fn: count, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: Inverter temperatures
panels.description: Works with the current temperature simulator; exact names depend on the chosen DBC.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "home")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "can_signal" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.signal =~ /^INV_.*(Temp|Temperature)/)

list.name: dbc_file
list.label: DBC file
list.query:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
schema.tagValues(bucket: "home", tag: "dbc", predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "can_signal", start: -24h)
